deals.offerEn: Even after JD Food Delivery subsidies were reduced, coupons can still be stacked: grab the hourly ¥20-off-¥29 gold coupon, then stack a small ¥3-off-¥4 or ¥4-off-¥5 coupon, while PLUS members can also claim a daily limited food-delivery subsidy. During tournaments, a JDG win may also trigger a ¥15-off-¥19 coupon.

deals.riskEn: Gold coupons are released on the hour in limited quantities and may sell out quickly; the PLUS daily subsidy is also limited. Pre-paid food cards and bulk-purchase coupons have recently attracted complaints about deductions when refunding, so avoid pre-paid options.
